title: The Tide Prints

cards.text: Wet footprints walk out of the sea and stop at my door.
They're bare, they're my size, and nobody else lives on this beach.
Every morning, they stop one step closer to where I sleep.
Last night, I sat on the porch with a torch to see who it was.
At 3am, someone waded out of the black water, dripping.
It walked right past me and whispered, "Your turn to go back."
At sunrise, I woke up waist-deep in cold water.
Someone in my window was waving goodbye.

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
